first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence links shorter onboarding to improved time-to-value and adoption, with activation messaging as a complementary lever. A guarded simplification test best addresses the current funnel problem while avoiding promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention. Monitor qualified activation, conversion quality, and downstream retention to prevent lower-friction signups from reducing customer value.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding simplification experiment because completion is down 4% and the verified record shows a durable improvement in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention. Measure activation, qualified conversion, time-to-value, and retention to ensure increased completion translates into sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging is also validated, but onboarding directly addresses both current funnel problems and is the stronger single intervention for this week.
